name: Magic UI
summary: Fantasy and RPG UI sound effects library: menu, select, confirm, level-up and loot sounds, royalty-free.
description: A sound effects library for fantasy and RPG game interfaces: menus, selections, confirmations, loot, rewards and quests, built from recordings of wood, stone, metal, glass and leather with magical tonal layers. Sold as a Construction Kit, a Designed edition or both combined, with a royalty-free license and UCS-compatible embedded metadata.
